name: Magnetism (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
School transmutation [metal]; Level sorcerer/wizard 3

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, M (a piece of lodestone)

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Effect ray

Duration 1 round/level

Saving Throw see text; Spell Resistance no

Metal: Spells with this descriptor include those that directly create, utilize, or manipulate metal in some manner or conjure creatures composed of metal. Such spells are considered to belong to the Metal element (for geomancers) and the metal elemental school (for metal elementalists).

Each round as a standard action, you can make a ranged touch attack to draw a metallic object to your hand with an effective Strength of 30. If the object is held by another creature, you make opposed Strength checks.

The target gets a +4 circumstance bonus to this check if the object is held in two hands. If the object is on a creature’s person, they may attempt a Reflex save to grab the item before it flies away, then making the Strength check. If the object is secured, you use the 30 Strength to attempt to break or burst the restraint.
